conditioning.name: Treadmill - Starter 8 x 1 min
conditioning.purpose: Initial return to treadmill running after the layoff.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 8 x 1 min jog with 1 min walking recovery. Running pace progressed approximately 6.5-7.5 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - Starter Week
conditioning.purpose: Historical starter-week return-to-running session.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Starter-week controlled run-walk session. Exact original interval prescription is not reliably preserved.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 6 x 90 sec
conditioning.purpose: Progress from the starter week to longer controlled running intervals.

parts.name: Warm-up
parts.detail: Walk 3 min @ 4.2 km/h, then 4 min @ 5.2 km/h.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 6 x 90 sec run @ 7.0 km/h, then 2 min walk @ 5.0 km/h.

parts.name: Cooldown
parts.detail: 2 min @ 5.0 km/h, then 3 min @ 4.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 6 x 2 min
conditioning.purpose: Increase each running interval to two minutes.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 6 x 2 min run @ 7.0 km/h, then 2 min walk @ 5.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 5 x 3 min
conditioning.purpose: Increase running interval duration while slightly reducing the number of repetitions.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 5 x 3 min run @ 7.0 km/h, then 2 min walk @ 5.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 5 x 4 min
conditioning.purpose: Increase individual running intervals while keeping the pace easy.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 5 x 4 min run @ 7.0 km/h, then 2 min walk @ 5.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 4 x 5 min
conditioning.purpose: Finish the pre-cruise block with longer controlled intervals.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 4 x 5 min run @ 7.0 km/h, then 2 min walk @ 5.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - Re-Entry 4 x 4 min
conditioning.purpose: Ease back into running after the cruise instead of immediately progressing.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 4 x 4 min run @ 7.0 km/h, then 2 min walk @ 5.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 3 x 7 min
conditioning.purpose: Extend continuous running time within each interval.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 3 x 7 min run @ 7.2 km/h, then 2 min walk @ 5.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 3 x 8 min
conditioning.purpose: Continue extending running intervals while keeping effort controlled.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 3 x 8 min run @ 7.2 km/h, then 90 sec walk @ 5.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 2 x 10 min
conditioning.purpose: Reach double-digit continuous running intervals.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 2 x 10 min run @ 7.5 km/h with 2 min walking recovery.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - Post-Stag 3 x 8 min
conditioning.purpose: Re-establish rhythm after the stag weekend without forcing progression.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 3 x 8 min run @ 7.5 km/h, then 90 sec walk @ 5.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 2 x 12 min
conditioning.purpose: Move closer to sustained continuous running.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 2 x 12 min run @ 7.5 km/h with 2 min walking recovery.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 15 min + 10 min
conditioning.purpose: Complete one substantially longer continuous running block.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run 15 min @ 7.5 km/h, walk 2 min, then run 10 min @ 7.5 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 20 min Continuous
conditioning.purpose: Begin the continuous-running phase.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run continuously for 20 min @ approximately 7.5 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 25 min Continuous
conditioning.purpose: Extend continuous running toward 30 minutes.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run continuously for 25 min @ approximately 7.5 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 20 min Easy
conditioning.purpose: Easy consolidation rather than another progression.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run continuously for 20 min @ approximately 7.5 km/h. Keep this genuinely easy.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 30 min Continuous
conditioning.purpose: Achieve the first major goal of 30 minutes of continuous running.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run continuously for 30 min @ approximately 7.5 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 6 x 3 min Faster
conditioning.purpose: Introduce faster running without requiring it to be sustained continuously.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 6 x 3 min @ 8.5 km/h with 90 sec easy walk or jog between reps.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 25 min Easy
conditioning.purpose: Maintain continuous running ability between faster sessions.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run continuously for 25 min @ 7.5-7.8 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 32 min Continuous
conditioning.purpose: Build a small endurance reserve beyond the eventual 30-minute target.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run continuously for 32 min @ approximately 7.8 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 5 x 4 min Faster
conditioning.purpose: Increase the amount of moderately fast running.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 5 x 4 min @ 9.0 km/h with 90 sec easy walk or jog between reps.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 35 min Continuous
conditioning.purpose: Build endurance beyond the time required for the target 5K.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run continuously for 35 min @ approximately 8.0 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 4 x 5 min Faster
conditioning.purpose: Move closer to target 5K pace.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 4 x 5 min @ 9.5 km/h with 2 min easy walk or jog between reps.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 30 min Steady
conditioning.purpose: Increase sustainable continuous running speed.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run continuously for 30 min @ approximately 8.5 km/h.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 3 x 6 min Goal Pace
conditioning.purpose: Introduce meaningful blocks at the eventual 30-minute 5K pace.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 3 x 6 min @ 10.0 km/h with 2 min easy walk or jog between reps.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 3 x 8 min Goal Pace
conditioning.purpose: Accumulate 24 minutes at target 5K pace.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: 3 x 8 min @ 10.0 km/h with 2 min easy walk or jog between reps.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 5K Tune-Up
conditioning.purpose: Keep the legs moving and briefly touch target pace without creating fatigue.

parts.name: Easy running
parts.detail: Run 20 min easy @ approximately 8.0 km/h.

parts.name: Goal pace strides
parts.detail: 4 x 1 min @ 10.0 km/h with 1 min very easy between reps.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - 30-Minute 5K Attempt
conditioning.purpose: Attempt the primary goal of a continuous 5 km in approximately 30 minutes.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Set treadmill to 10.0 km/h and run continuously for 5.0 km. Target time: 30:00.

conditioning.name: Treadmill - Recovery Run
conditioning.purpose: Recover from the 5K attempt without adding another hard session.

parts.name: Main set
parts.detail: Run 15-20 min very easy @ approximately 7.5-8.0 km/h. Stop while still feeling fresh.

mobility.name: Pre-Run Dynamic Mobility
mobility.purpose: Prepare the ankles, calves, knees and hips immediately before treadmill running.

parts.name: Ankle rocks
parts.detail: 8-10 reps per side.

parts.name: Calf raises
parts.detail: 10 controlled reps.

parts.name: Leg swings
parts.detail: 10 front-to-back and 10 side-to-side per leg.

parts.name: Walking lunges
parts.detail: 6 reps per side.

parts.name: Marching and light skips
parts.detail: 60-90 seconds total.
